name: Spicy Tortilla Egg Roll with Avocado & Pico de Gallo Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl.
Trim cucumber, then halve lengthwise and slice thinly crosswise. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Halve grape tomatoes. Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips; transfer both to the bowl with the garlic.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice the lime into the bowl and season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine the salad, then set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Crack the eggs into another medium bowl and season with salt and pepper; whisk together.
Once the skillet is hot, add the oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Pour one-quarter of the egg mixture (or about ⅓ cup) into the skillet and swirl to make an omelet the size of a tortilla. Let cook, undisturbed, for 30 seconds. Before the egg fully sets, place a tortilla on top and press down gently with a spatula. When egg is cooked, after about 1 minute, flip tortilla and cook for 30 seconds more; transfer to a plate and cover with aluminum foil.
Add more oil (½ tsp per tortilla) to the skillet and repeat with remaining egg mixture and tortillas.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Lay the tortillas, egg-side-up, on a flat surface; divide the avocado, pico de gallo salad, and chili-garlic sauce between them. Roll tightly to close, then slice each roll in half.
To serve, divide rolls between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
